textual_summary: AMCA advance accelerates private consortia participation with HAL exclusion, three bidders remain, and L1 cost-based selection. Aviation Week corroborates HAL knockout with TASL, L&T, and Kalyani Group contending; final award anticipated in coming months. Separately, India approves a 3.6 trillion rupee defence upgrade (Rafale and P-8I), with HAL engine-delivery constraints impacting Tejas Mk1A and Macron’s visit signaling France-India aerospace collaboration. watch for RFP cadence, domestic capacity shifts, and international partnerships shaping AMCA timelines.
